lines: A module is delivered more than once inside a single page:
collectives-main: 197 B beyond the first copy, generated by vite 197 B.
moment, 292,945 B on the collectives-main page: carries its locale data; luxon and date-fns are a fraction of it.
vite-plugin-node-polyfills, 57,185 B on the collectives-init page: Node APIs polyfilled into a browser bundle.
845,125 B in 2 pieces of 2 files have no owner: no mapping covers them, and the code matches no file of a neighbouring module, of the app, or of the bundler and its plugins.

collectives-main.mjs at byte 19,641, 845,116 B, after ../node_modules/@nextcloud/vue/dist/chunks/NcAppSettingsSection-B-ak1kbx.mjs: "parse('[{\"id\":\"smileys\",\"name\":\"Smileys & Emotion\",\"emojis\":"
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (74 packages, 645 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
No bundler chunk in js and css is left without something that loads it.
